turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hello, and I can help with that. To find your claim, please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.

Thank you, Mr. Okonkwo. I have verified order SC-3072. Because you reject the staff decision on your damage claim, I have passed your case to a colleague who will take over and review it with you. Please wait for their reply.

input.summary: Verified customer Patrick Okonkwo (patrick.okonkwo@example.com), order SC-3072 (delivered). He filed a damage claim about pale patches on the print. Staff closed the claim and decided the pale patches are part of the drawing. The customer rejects that decision and wants it reviewed by a person.
